decision: TARGET: rewrite pi-orchestrator as a PiG-native Go extension embedding moejs; TS core stays, loaded via moejs CompileTS
evidence: moejs is a pure-Go JS runtime for plugins inside Go programs; PiG prefers Go extensions (docs extensions.md); PiG Go SDK v0.7.0 fetches; pig extension init --lang go scaffolds+builds
alternatives rejected: standalone Go binary (loses in-session orch_* tools); keep TS extension (moejs impossible in Node host)

decision: ARCHITECTURE: thin Go shell (PiG SDK wiring) + whole TS core on moejs + shim layer (node:path/os/crypto/url/child_process/assert + orch:fs wrapper)
evidence: U1 probe: real layerfs-engine.ts ran full wave (L1->branch->C3->merge->L2, hostMatchesLayer true) under moejs with shims
alternatives rejected: Go-native engine rewrite (loses 300KB test suites as parity oracle, doubles port surface, moejs becomes decorative)

decision: LOADER TRANSFORM: rewrite specifier "node:fs" -> "orch:fs" at CompileTS time for repo files only
evidence: moejs node pkg lacks bigint stats + chmodSync; wrapper adds them; core source stays Node-runnable unchanged

decision: SHIM: bigint stats via JS bigify over number stats (mtimeNs from float mtimeMs, ~us precision)
evidence: moejs lstatSync({bigint:true}) throws 'not implemented'; engine fingerprints need dev/ino/mode/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs as BigInt
alternatives rejected: Go-native lstat returning BigInt (no public moejs constructor path)

decision: SHIM GOTCHA: bigified Stats must override isFile/isDirectory/isSymbolicLink (prototype methods ToNumber the BigInt mode/size and throw)
evidence: probe stack: 'Stats.isFile -> Cannot convert a BigInt value to a number' at verifyOneHostPath

decision: SHIM: crypto.createHash sha256 via Go native + base64 round-trip for Buffers
evidence: 4 call sites, all sha256; Buffer bytes not extractable via public moejs API; base64 is exact

decision: SHIM: chmodSync via Go os.Chmod native
evidence: moejs node pkg stubs it; engine restores modes on apply/restore

decision: PARITY ORACLE: 8/11 suites pass UNMODIFIED under the moejs runner (extension/cmd/moetest)
evidence: tool-gate 17/17, thinking-levels 31/31, waves 45/45, session-config 52/52, test.ts ALL PASSED, primitives 41/41, packaging-manifest 11/11, packaging-docs 27/27

decision: PORT ITEMS REMAIN: test-regressions needs node:module (CJS interop = Node-runtime contract, re-scope to moejs), test-extension-wiring tests node --check + Pi TS API (rewrite for Go SDK), test-worker-session spawns pi via getPiInvocation (adapt invocation for Go extension)
evidence: measured: those 3 suites fail under runner for exactly these reasons

decision: SPAWN BRIDGE: Loop.NewPromise per spawn is the liveness root; close settles via loop settle fn (emits close+signalCode); stdout/stderr chunks post as tasks with (id,event,b64); data tasks run while promise pending
evidence: spawn-test.ts: STDOUT/STDERR/CLOSE(3) all arrive in order; primitives supervisor tests 41/41 incl SIGTERM-ignore + SIGKILL escalation
alternatives rejected: rt.NewPromise (not loop-aware, loop exits and posts drop), postEmit without id (arg shift bug)

decision: LOOP LIVENESS RULES LEARNED: Load returns ErrModulePending for TLA modules and Run-fn must treat it as success; only ref'd timers, immediates, Holds, loop-NewPromises and queued tasks keep Run alive; posts after loop exit are dropped
evidence: async-test.ts failed until both fixes; guide.md 'Running a loop'

decision: RUNNER -e MODE: probe -e <code> + process.execPath=os.Executable() + process.on(signal) installs Go signal.Notify (ignore) so supervisor tests' children behave like node -e
evidence: process.exit(9) exits 9; SIGTERM-ignoring child survives TERM and needs KILL

decision: SHIM ADDITIONS: node:assert/strict (pure JS, strict semantics), node:url (URL+fileURLToPath+import.meta.url via Importer.Meta), node:child_process (Go-backed), AbortController/AbortSignal (pure JS), console with JS-side stringify (Go Value.String() gives '[object Error]'), fs.promises overrides, symlinkSync/mkdtempSync/utimesSync via Go natives
evidence: per-suite failures fixed in sequence; webapi needs cgo and this host has no C compiler, so URL is hand-shimmed
